reviewNotes: Held back: the page gives no year for the tune; the score has a bar of another length (bar 12), which the solfa grid does not draw. Imported from CCEH tune 001266 (the melody read from 001266a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Samuel Sebastian Wesley's dates (1810–1876) are from our page for the tune AURELIA (content/hymns/tunes/aurelia.json); CCEH's page gives none. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001266a.nwc).
